fix_subject: One of the optimizations of check-in [de9c86c9e4cdb34f] does not work for terms originating in the ON/USING clause, as demonstrated by [forum:/forumpost/6cf3bb457c3f4685|forum post 6cf3bb457c3f4685].  This check-in disables that optimization for ON/USING terms.  Also improve the TreeView display for the resulting "true"/"false" nodes to show that they originate from the ON/USING clause.  Add a testcase() to the other optimization to show that it can still be used for ON/USING terms.
